method: One-off private travel dataset research using public Photon, 1 sequential request per 1.5 seconds, no Airbnb private property geocoding. Two wrong same-name hotel matches were corrected using independently published addresses/coordinates. After automated research, 19 unambiguous reviewed candidates were manually reconciled with public map features and/or independent published coordinates. Area/path centroids are explicitly labelled. Additional published geographic coordinates were individually sourced from official municipal, tourist, hotel, OSM map and railway-station records; no city-centre approximation. Group activities have explicitly qualified area/landmark centres.

legend.unique_osm_named_poi: One uniquely named OSM object near source city; may be polygon centre

accuracy: OSM map coordinates are source identifiers or polygon centroids; not surveyed entrances; no 2027 routing claims. Source map points do not imply real-time opening hours or walking access. General outdoor activity pins represent only the stated park/beach/area anchor, not a bookable event position, walking-route path or accommodation entrance.
